payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a financial dashboard. Use: revenue/expense charts, profit margins, budget vs actual, cash flow waterfall, financial ratios, audit trail table, currency formatting, period comparisons.
payload.best_for: Financial reporting, accounting dashboards, portfolio tracking, budget monitoring, banking analytics
payload.css_technical_keywords: number formatting (Intl.NumberFormat), waterfall chart (positive/negative bars), variance coloring, table with totals row, sparkline for trends, sticky column headers
payload.do_not_use_for: Simple business dashboards, entertainment/social metrics, non-financial data
payload.effects_and_animation: Number animations (count-up), trend direction indicators, percentage change animations, profit/loss color transitions
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Currency formatted, ☐ Decimals consistent, ☐ P&L clear, ☐ Budget variance shown, ☐ Audit trail complete, ☐ Export to Excel
payload.keywords: Revenue metrics, profit/loss visualization, budget tracking, financial ratios, portfolio performance, cash flow, audit trail
payload.primary_colors: Financial colors: profit (green #22C55E), loss (red #EF4444), neutral (grey), trust (dark blue #003366)
payload.secondary_colors: Revenue highlight (green), expenses (red), budget variance (orange/red), balance (grey), accuracy (blue)
